summary: A senior property tax freeze kept the city's share of a bill from rising after reassessment, though the other taxes still went up.
realLife: St. Louis's Senior Property Tax Freeze Credit keeps a senior's city property tax from rising after a reassessment. The credit covers city taxes only, not school, library or other districts. In the city's own hypothetical for 2025, a $100,000 home reassessed 12 percent higher would see total taxes rise $187 without the freeze and $154 with it, a saving of $33. So the credit softens the rise but does not stop it.
sources: https://www.stlouis-mo.gov/government/departments/assessor/news/2025-tax-freeze-credit-update.cfm (St. Louis Assessor page with a worked example of the freeze credit)
